events.title: Roman Republic foundations
events.description: Rome grows from city-state influence into control of Italy.

events.title: Punic Wars and western expansion
events.description: Roman victories over Carthage reshape the western Mediterranean.

events.title: Late Republican conquests
events.description: Campaigns in Hispania, Gaul, Greece, and North Africa dramatically widen territory.

events.title: Imperial ascent
events.description: From Augustus to Trajan, the empire expands to its greatest recorded extent.

events.title: Stabilization and pressure
events.description: Defensive strategy, internal crises, and frontier pressure reduce cohesion and size.

events.title: Western decline
events.description: The western half contracts until imperial authority ends in 476 CE.

events.title: Departure from Palos
events.description: Christopher Columbus departs Palos de la Frontera, Spain.

events.title: Canary Islands – La Gomera
events.description: The fleet stops at La Gomera for repairs and provisions.

events.title: Westbound into the Atlantic
events.description: The fleet departs La Gomera and sails west into open ocean.

events.title: Mid-Atlantic crossing
events.description: Weeks at sea with no sight of land.

events.title: Approaching the Bahamas
events.description: Signs of land spotted; birds and floating vegetation appear.

events.title: Landfall at San Salvador
events.description: Land is sighted and Columbus makes landfall in the Bahamas.
